title: Gravitee · Call Logs
description: Headers and payloads of logged API calls, on the client and backend side: search them, list failed calls, and inspect one call hop by hop.

options.content:
**Call logs** record the headers and payloads of API calls, on the client side and on the backend side. They're
written only for APIs with **logging enabled** (API → *Logs* → *Configure Reporting*), for the calls that match
its condition. The demo logs **1 call in 5** on every API. Logs are much bigger than analytics records,
so enable them per API, with a condition or for a limited time.

**Search** (Lucene) matches payloads with wildcards, e.g. `*wayne-enterprises*` or `*EUR*`, and any indexed field,
e.g. `entrypoint-response.status:503`, `error-key:RATE_LIMIT_TOO_MANY_REQUESTS` or `application-name:"Retail Web"`.
Headers are stored but not searchable. Click a **Request id** to show that call below, or open one from the
*Request id* links in **API Drill-down**. ⚠️ Logs can contain personal data and credentials: credential headers are
hidden here, but restrict access to this data source.

panels.title: Share of calls logged
panels.description: Logged calls / all calls in the analytics index. Logging conditions (sampling, a debug header…) and APIs without logging keep this below 100 %.

panels.title: Answered by the Gateway
panels.description: Logged calls the Gateway answered without calling the backend (backend status 0): rejected by plan security or a policy such as rate limiting.

panels.title: Logged failed calls
panels.description: Click a request id to show its headers and payloads below.

panels.title: Payloads
panels.description: Bodies at each hop. Comparing 1↔2 or 3↔4 shows what policies changed (transformation, masking). The Gateway caps logged bodies, so large payloads may be truncated.
